phase3_findings.description: Mixed-mode invocation (config flag AND positional labels) silently discards the positional labels — _CONFIG_MODE wins with no breadcrumb. No in-tree call site mixes modes; fails toward the config value, not data loss.

ensure-label.sh outcome fully discarded inside the creation loop (stdout>/dev/null, stderr uninspected, always exits 0). phase3_findings.description: Config mode with a missing --config-fallback: _CONFIG_FALLBACK defaults to "" and config mode is entered whenever either flag appears, so an absent configured value resolves to empty → nothing-to-apply rather than intended fallback. All four in-tree call sites pass both flags; defensive-coding note.
phase3_findings.fix_decision: advisory (unreachable from in-tree callers; fails safe; below threshold)

A marker-file probe asserting the ensure POST fired during an apply would close the gap.
phase3_findings.fix_decision: advisory (below threshold; core token contract fully covered)

phase3_findings.description: arg-slip stdout token asserted only for the non-numeric shape, not the empty/missing-number shape (both share one case arm; low risk).
api-failure and config-unreadable each exercised in only one mode; post-resolution apply code is shared, so a completeness note rather than a real risk.

nothing-to-apply stderr breadcrumb wording ('the caller passed an empty/whitespace-only label list') misdescribes the cause when the empty set arose from a config value that normalized to nothing. Byte-for-byte preservation is an explicit AC, so this is a genuine tension, harmless (token still nothing-to-apply).
phase3_findings.fix_decision: advisory (below threshold; breadcrumb intentionally byte-frozen per AC)

report:
## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (issue #1855 label-config fold is correct and well-tested; one Important comment-completeness note capped to Suggestion as behavior-inert prose, plus advisory Suggestions)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #1855 — criteria from the /prflow:implement workpad — scope unchanged. The change satisfies the specification: `apply-labels.sh` gains `--config-key/--config-fallback` mode that resolves the label list via `config-get.sh`, folds per-label creation through the sibling `ensure-label.sh` (stdout suppressed), applies via the same REST `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/labels`, always exits 0, and prints exactly one stdout token from the closed set {applied, nothing-to-apply, arg-slip, api-failure, config-unreadable} on every path (a harness refusal is the sole no-output outcome). `ensure-label.sh`'s already-exists test moved from `grep -qiE` to a bash `case` under `nocasematch` (no non-preflight PATH tool), preserving the three arms and case-insensitivity. The four implement call sites (Phase 3.1 provenance, 4.0, 4.0.5, 4.1) collapse to one token-routing invocation each. Every stderr breadcrumb is preserved byte-for-byte.

## Verification Checklist Results
20 passed, 0 failed, 0 inconclusive — checklist claims (token contract, flag parsing, [object Object] substring guard, folded per-label ensure with stdout suppression, grep→case/nocasematch swap, byte-identical stderr, four call-site token routing) each confirmed against the shipped `scripts/apply-labels.sh`, `scripts/ensure-label.sh`, `scripts/config-get.sh` and `lib/test/run.sh` by the code-reviewer and final-pass reviewers.

## Code Review Findings
### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor
1. Contract-header comment at scripts/apply-labels.sh:31 under-specifies the `config-unreadable` trigger set — it names only the config-get-non-zero path and omits the `[object Object]` wrong-type guard path (where config-get exits 0); docs/internal/implement-skill.md states it correctly (raised by 1/5 agents) [suspected over-grade: behavior-inert prose cap — internal contract-header comment, no tool reads it for behavior, not consumer-facing; both inertness limbs hold; under-specifies rather than false against HEAD so not a self-contradicting-diff carve-out; capped from Important to Suggestion].
2. Mixed-mode invocation (config flag + positional labels) silently discards the positional labels; no in-tree call site mixes modes (raised by 1/5 agents).
3. ensure-label.sh creation-loop outcome discarded — a genuine creation failure is mis-attributed to the apply POST (api-failure), not fully silent (raised by 1/5 agents).
4. Config mode with a missing --config-fallback resolves an absent value to empty → nothing-to-apply; all in-tree callers pass both flags (raised by 2/5 agents).
5. Several new comment blocks exceed the prevention-only three-line cap with worked examples/provenance, but each is load-bearing (raised by 1/5 agents).
6. Test gaps: the folded ensure POST is executed but never observed by an `applied` assertion; the empty-number arg-slip token, and api-failure/config-unreadable in the alternate mode, are inferred rather than asserted (raised by 1/5 agents).
7. nothing-to-apply stderr breadcrumb wording misdescribes the cause in config mode, but is intentionally byte-frozen per the byte-identical-breadcrumb AC (raised by 1/5 agents).

over-grade annotation: one finding flagged and capped (behavior-inert prose cap — scripts/apply-labels.sh:31, Important → Suggestion).
truthfulness sweep: no finding promoted.

- No verification-checklist FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE.
- No self-contradicting-diff carve-out finding (the one Important is an incomplete-but-true comment, not false against HEAD; capped behavior-inert per Phase 4.1.5).
- No finding at or above the default `critical` verdict threshold.
- Only findings below threshold present → APPROVE with notes.

No blocking issues. The change is correct, satisfies issue #1855, and is well-covered by new behavioral tests; the notes are optional polish (a one-clause header broadening at scripts/apply-labels.sh:31 would clear the sole Important-origin item).
